name: @forgeax/engine-import
description: Asset import and Pack production: build-time filesystem/DDC adapters and a browser-safe, opt-in runtime producer share identity, output encoding and validation contracts.

bundle-size.reason: runtime producer is opt-in; its shipped closure is measured by consuming App/SDK gates, with no independent package threshold yet

fps.reason: data production has no canvas or frame loop

bench.reason: import and runtime generation are explicit operations; no standalone performance threshold is registered yet

gate.reason: no standalone binary gate; package-level gates declared in CI yaml directly
